Cancellation & Refund Policy

Project costs, material returns and pending commercial particulars.

Business details pending confirmation. Square-bracket items are placeholders, not agreed contract terms. Last updated: 13 November 2026.

1. Scope and written quotation

This policy concerns flooring and waterproofing service bookings. Contact us in writing using your name and quotation/project reference to request cancellation. Before paying, the quotation must identify the scope, advance, included visit/transport charges and the applicable cancellation terms. B2C advances normally range from 40%–80% by project; B2B terms start with 40% against the accepted purchase order, with remaining milestones agreed in writing.

2. Cancellation before material purchase

If the customer cancels before materials are purchased, all money paid will be refunded within one week, with no cancellation or site-visit deduction. Site-visit and transport charges included in the quotation do not change this pre-purchase full-refund rule.

3. After materials have been purchased

The business’s stated commercial rule is deduction of material cost, transport and an additional charge equal to 10% of the total quotation, with the remaining refundable advance returned. The particular deductions must be stated and agreed in advance, explained in an itemised reconciliation, and remain subject to applicable consumer law and reasonableness. The 10% charge requires lawyer review; it is not a waiver of statutory remedies or an automatic penalty enforceable in every situation.

Where materials can be returned, the refund/credit actually recovered from the supplier is taken into account and passed through in the customer reconciliation. There must not be double recovery of a material cost and the corresponding supplier refund. Supplier return conditions and project timing/size affect the reconciliation. This page does not authorise a separate, undisclosed labour or other cancellation deduction.

4. Refund timing and method

Before material purchase, a full refund is due within one week. For post-purchase cancellations, the refund timeline is 7–15 working days following receipt of the cancellation request; any supplier-return reconciliation and expected credit date will be explained in writing. Supplier-return credits must be accounted for without double recovery. The refund calculation and any outstanding supplier credit must be explained in writing; mandatory legal timelines and remedies prevail. Refund method: Bank transfer or UPI.

5. Changes, defective work and mandatory rights

A change in scope or schedule is not automatically the same as cancellation; agree revised costs and dates in writing. This cancellation policy does not remove remedies for defective work, misrepresentation or other rights available under applicable law. Review warranty complaints separately under the accepted project warranty.

6. Request cancellation or a statement

Email shivamvish101@gmail.com or call +91 95698 37456. Grievance contact: Shivam Vishvakarma, Owner — shivamvish101@gmail.com.

Final project terms: quotation and warranty card

Final project-specific scope, commercial terms and warranty conditions are set out in the accepted quotation and matching warranty card. They are based on the site, coating system, surface condition, intended use, area, operating conditions and customer requirements. Agree these terms in writing before payment or work begins; the warranty card must match the accepted agreement. Website service descriptions and warranty ranges are general guidance. These project documents do not override our privacy or cookie commitments, mandatory legal rights, or permit unilateral changes to agreed terms. Any inconsistency must be clarified and agreed in writing.
